name: Domino's India
description: From quick lunches to late-night cravings and weekend celebrations, Domino's is ready whenever hunger strikes. Browse the latest menu, customise your meal how you like it, unlock exciting offers, and order with ease for a fast, delicious experience. Domino's India ordering MCP (India only). Menu browse and store lookup may work without sign-in. All transactional and personal-data tools require an OTP-authenticated session .

_published_faq.name: How do I add Domino's India to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Domino's India to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://genai-prod-ext.dominos.co.in/order-mcp/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Domino's India MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Domino's India scores 90/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Domino's India MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Domino's India lists 15 MCP tools, including browse-menu, get-applicable-promos, get-loyalty-menu, get-product-recommendations, get-recent-orders-for-reorder, get-saved-addresses, get-wallet-balance, initialize-shopping-cart, manage-auth-otp, manage-loyalty-enrollment, order-status, and place-order.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Domino's India?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Domino's India in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.

_published_faq.name: Does Domino's India MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Domino's India does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Domino's India is developed by Jubilant Foodworks Limited. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
